AGENDA
  AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or requests for assistance,
call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and
available for viewing on the City’s website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. Audit Reports are
available for viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-performance-
and-audit/audit-reports.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All
documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the City Clerk’s Office at 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA
91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the service
as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-2090, at least 24 hours
prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

  April 22, 2019 at 8:00 AM

 1. ROLL CALL

 2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The agenda for the April 22, 2019 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on Thursday, April 18,
  2019 on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

 3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

 4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting held on October 29, 2018
  b. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 28, 2019

 5. ACTION ITEMS

 6. REPORTS – INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 3/31/2019 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager

 7. COMMITTEE /STAFF COMMENTS
 8. NEW BUSINESS

9. ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  April 22, 2019

1.  Roll Call:  8:00 a.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy,
  Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of April 22, 2019 was posted on Thursday,
  April 18, 2019 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting held on Monday,
  October 29, 2018

  Vote as follows:

 Audit Committee Minutes
April 22, 2019

  Audit Committee Chair Zareh Amirian welcomed Mr. Vahik Satoorian as the new Audit
  Committee member. Chair Amirian mentioned that he has worked with Mr. Satoorian in
  the past and looks forward to working with him again as he brings his insights and
  experience to the Audit Committee.

5.  ACTION ITEMS

  None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION

  A.  Internal Audit Activity Report as of March 31, 2019 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Internal Audit Manager, Jessie Zhang opened her quarterly activity report by introducing the
  presentation of the one completed audit project during the quarter ended March 31, 2019.

  Sr. Internal Auditor, Sameel Salim presented the Glendale Police Department Property Room
  Audit. Internal Audit concluded that the GPD Property Room has established and
  implemented processes and controls that provide reasonable assurance that property and
  evidence items are received, processed, safeguarded, and disposed of properly. Internal Audit
  identified seven improvement opportunities related to video camera surveillance coverage and
  retention, property in transit monitoring, physical and logical access controls, data entry
  consistency and reporting, property destruction, and policies and procedures. Police Property
  Supervisor, Heather Howison and Police Civilian Division Commander, Sheryl Davis-Moore
  were present and answered questions from the Committee members.

  Ms. Zhang concluded her quarterly activity report presentation by providing updates on
  projects in progress and quarterly follow-up activities, and answered questions from the
  Committee members.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

  None

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None

9.  ADJOURNMENT

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Adjournment at 9:10 a.m.
